statement: Both consumers use feature1 command 0x87 with one (u8 setting, u16 LE value) entry, header [0x87,0x03]. SETTING_IMU_MODE index48; enable value 0x0018 enables raw accel+gyro; disable 0x0000. Thus sample 64-byte requests begin [0x01,0x87,0x03,0x30,0x18,0x00] and [0x01,0x87,0x03,0x30,0x00,0x00]. Linux sends on sensor open/close; SDL sends in SetSensorsEnabled, not necessarily base joystick open. No SET_REPORT response body is asserted. Linux:145-245,936-978; SDL driver:653-676.
